segments.ja519:1.1: Kā vedhamānā girikandarāyaṃ, ekā tuvaṃ tiṭṭhasi saṃhitūru [saññatūra (sī. pī.), sañcitūru (syā.)];
segments.ja519:1.3: Puṭṭhāsi me pāṇipameyyamajjhe, akkhāhi me nāmañca bandhave ca.
segments.ja519:2.3: Kā vā tvamasi kalyāṇi, kassa vā tvaṃ sumajjhime;
segments.ja519:2.5: Abhivādemi taṃ bhadde, dānavāhaṃ namatthu te.
segments.ja519:3.1: Yo putto kāsirājassa, sotthisenoti taṃ vidū;
segments.ja519:3.3: Tassāhaṃ sambulā bhariyā, evaṃ jānāhi dānava;
segments.ja519:3.5: Abhivādemi taṃ bhante [bhaddante (sī. syā.)], sambulāhaṃ namatthu te.
segments.ja519:5.3: Yadā harāmi taṃ bhakkho, tassa nūnajja nādhati [nāthati (ka.)].
segments.ja519:6.3: Sambule pariciṇṇena, ahaṃ bhattā bhavāmi te.
segments.ja519:7.1: Sokaṭṭāya durattāya, kiṃ rūpaṃ vijjate mama;
segments.ja519:8.1: Ehimaṃ girimāruyha, bhariyā me [mayhaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] catussatā;
segments.ja519:9.1: Nūna [nanu (sī. syā. pī. ka.)] tārakavaṇṇābhe [hāṭakavaṇṇābhe (pī.)], yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi;
segments.ja519:9.3: Sabbaṃ taṃ pacuraṃ mayhaṃ, ramassvajja [ramasujja (sī. syā.)] mayā saha.
segments.ja519:10.1: No ce tuvaṃ maheseyyaṃ, sambule kārayissasi;
segments.ja519:10.3: Alaṃ tvaṃ pātarāsāya, paṇhe [maññe (sī. pī.)] bhakkhā bhavissasi.
segments.ja519:11.3: Vane nāthaṃ apassantiṃ, sambulaṃ aggahī bhuje.
segments.ja519:13.1: Na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ, yaṃ maṃ khādeyya rakkhaso;
segments.ja519:13.3: Yañca me ayyaputtassa, mano hessati aññathā.
segments.ja519:14.1: Na santi devā pavasanti nūna, na hi nūna santi idha lokapālā;
segments.ja519:14.3: Sahasā karontānamasaññatānaṃ, na hi nūna santi paṭisedhitāro.
segments.ja519:15.1: Itthīnamesā pavarā yasassinī, santā samā aggirivuggatejā;
segments.ja519:15.3: Tañce tuvaṃ rakkhasādesi kaññaṃ, muddhā ca hi sattadhā te phaleyya;
segments.ja519:15.5: Mā tvaṃ dahī [jahī (pī.)] muñca patibbatāya [patibbatā sā (sī.), patibbatā yā (pī.)].
segments.ja519:16.3: Nīḷaṃ [niḍḍaṃ (syā. ka.)] paḷinaṃ sakuṇīva [phalinasakuṇīva (sī. syā. pī.)], gatasiṅgaṃva ālayaṃ.
segments.ja519:18.3: Rājaputtaṃ apassantī, tumhaṃmhi [tumhaṃ hi (pī.)] saraṇaṃ gatā.
segments.ja519:19.1: Vande sīhe ca byagghe ca, ye ca aññe vane migā;
segments.ja519:20.1: Tiṇā [tiṇa (pī.)] latāni osadhyo, pabbatāni vanāni ca;
segments.ja519:24.3: Kena nujja samāgacchi [samāgacchi (sī. pī.)], ko te piyataro mayā.
segments.ja519:25.1: Idaṃ khohaṃ tadāvocaṃ [tadavocaṃ (sī. syā.)], gahitā tena sattunā;
segments.ja519:25.3: Na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ, yaṃ maṃ khādeyya rakkhaso;
segments.ja519:25.5: Yañca me ayyaputtassa, mano hessati aññathā.
segments.ja519:27.1: Tathā maṃ saccaṃ pāletu, pālayissati ce mamaṃ;
segments.ja519:28.1: Ye kuñjarā sattasatā uḷārā, rakkhanti rattindivamuyyutāvudhā;
segments.ja519:28.3: Dhanuggahānañca satāni soḷasa, kathaṃvidhe passasi bhadde sattavo.
segments.ja519:29.3: Tāsaṃ suṇitvā mitagītavāditaṃ [mitagītavādinaṃ (pī.)], na dāni me tāta tathā yathā pure.
segments.ja519:30.3: Senopiyā [senūpiyā (pī.)] tāta aninditaṅgiyo, khattiyakaññā paṭilobhayanti [paṭilābhayanti (pī.)] naṃ.
segments.ja519:31.1: Sace ahaṃ tāta tathā yathā pure, patiṃ tamuñchāya punā vane bhare;
segments.ja519:31.3: Sammānaye maṃ na ca maṃ vimānaye, itopi me tāta tato varaṃ siyā.
segments.ja519:32.1: Yamannapāne vipulasmi ohite, nārī vimaṭṭhābharaṇā alaṅkatā;
segments.ja519:32.3: Sabbaṅgupetā [pañcaṅgupetā (sī. syā. pī.)] patino ca appiyā, abajjha [avajjha (syā.), ābajjha (pī.)] tassā maraṇaṃ tato varaṃ.
segments.ja519:33.1: Api ce daliddā kapaṇā anāḷhiyā, kaṭādutīyā patino ca sā piyā;
segments.ja519:33.3: Sabbaṅgupetāyapi appiyāya, ayameva seyyā [seyyo (syā. ka.)] kapaṇāpi yā piyā [kapaṇāpi yā (ka.)].
segments.ja519:34.1: Sudullabhitthī purisassa yā hitā, bhattitthiyā dullabho yo hito ca;
segments.ja519:34.3: Hitā ca te sīlavatī ca bhariyā, janinda dhammaṃ cara sambulāya.
segments.ja519:35.1: Sace tuvaṃ vipule laddhabhoge, issāvatiṇṇā maraṇaṃ upesi;
segments.ja519:35.3: Ahañca te bhadde imā rājakaññā [imā ca kaññā (pī.)], sabbe [sabbeva (sī. syā. pī.)] te vacanakarā bhavāmāti.

lines: Kā vā tvanti kā nāma vā tvaṃ bhavasi.
Dānavāhanti ahaṃ eko dānavo, ayaṃ namakkāro tava atthu, añjaliṃ te paggaṇhāmīti avaca.
Sā tassa vacanaṃ sutvā tisso gāthā abhāsi –
Tassāhaṃ sambulā bhariyā, evaṃ jānāhi dānava;
Abhivādemi taṃ bhante, sambulāhaṃ namatthu te.
Yadāharāmi taṃ bhakkho, tassa nūnajja nādhatī”ti.
Madhumaṃsanti nimmakkhikaṃ madhuñca migābilamaṃsañca sīhabyagghamigehi khāditamaṃsato atirittakoṭṭhāsaṃ.
Taṃ bhakkhoti yaṃ ahaṃ āharāmi, taṃ bhakkhova so mama sāmiko.
Tassa nūnajjāti tassa maññe ajja āhāraṃ alabhamānassa sarīraṃ ātape pakkhittapadumaṃ viya nādhati upatappati milāyati.
Tato paraṃ dānavassa ca tassā ca vacanapaṭivacanagāthāyo honti –
Sambule pariciṇṇena, ahaṃ bhattā bhavāmi te.
Sabbaṃ taṃ pacuraṃ mayhaṃ, ramassvajja mayā saha.
Alaṃ tvaṃ pātarāsāya, paṇhe bhakkhā bhavissasi.
Vane nāthaṃ apassantiṃ, sambulaṃ aggahī bhuje.
“Na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ, yaṃ maṃ khādeyya rakkhaso;
Yañca me ayyaputtassa, mano hessati aññathā.
“Na santi devā pavasanti nūna, na hi nūna santi idha lokapālā;
Sahasā karontānamasaññatānaṃ, na hi nūna santi paṭisedhitāro”ti.
Tattha pariciṇṇenāti tena āturena pariciṇṇena kiṃ karissasi.
Ehimanti mā tvaṃ durattāmhīti cintayi, etaṃ mama girimhi dibbavimānaṃ, ehi imaṃ giriṃ āruha.
Catussatāti tasmiṃ me vimāne aparāpi catussatā bhariyāyo atthi.
Sabbaṃ tanti yaṃ kiñci upabhogaparibhogavatthābharaṇādikaṃ icchasi, sabbaṃ taṃ nūna mayhaṃ pacuraṃ bahuṃ sulabhaṃ, tasmā mā kapaṇāmhīti cintayi, ehi mayā saha ramassūti vadati.

Maheseyyanti,“bhadde, sambule no ce me tvaṃ mahesibhāvaṃ kāressasi, pariyattā tvaṃ mama pātarāsāya, tena taṃ balakkārena vimānaṃ nessāmi, tatra maṃ asaṅgaṇhantī mama sve pātova bhakkhā bhavissasī”ti evaṃ vatvā so sattahi jaṭāhi samannāgato luddako dāruṇo nikkhantadanto taṃ tasmiṃ vane kiñci attano nāthaṃ apassantiṃ sambulaṃ bhuje aggahesi.
Mano hessatīti maṃ cirāyantiṃ viditvā aññathā cittaṃ bhavissati.
Na santi devāti idaṃ sā dānavena bhuje gahitā devatujjhāpanaṃ karontī āha.
Lokapālāti evarūpānaṃ sīlavantīnaṃ patidevatānaṃ pālakā lokapālā nūna idha loke na santīti paridevati.
Athassā sīlatejena sakkassa bhavanaṃ kampi, paṇḍukambalasilāsanaṃ uṇhākāraṃ dassesi.
Sakko āvajjento taṃ kāraṇaṃ ñatvā vajiraṃ ādāya vegena gantvā dānavassa matthake ṭhatvā itaraṃ gāthamāha –
Tañce tuvaṃ rakkhasādesi kaññaṃ, muddhā ca hi sattadhā te phaleyya;
Tattha santāti upasantā, atha vā paṇḍitā ñāṇasampannā.
Phaleyyāti iminā me indavajirena paharitvā muddhā bhijjetha.
Mā tvaṃ dahīti tvaṃ imaṃ patibbataṃ mā tāpeyyāsīti.
Sakko “punapi esa evarūpaṃ kareyyā”ti cintetvā dānavaṃ devasaṅkhalikāya bandhitvā puna anāgamanāya tatiye pabbatantare vissajjesi, rājadhītaraṃ appamādena ovaditvā sakaṭṭhānameva gato.
Rājadhītāpi atthaṅgate sūriye candālokena assamaṃ pāpuṇi.
Tamatthaṃ pakāsento satthā aṭṭha gāthā abhāsi –
“Vande sīhe ca byagghe ca, ye ca aññe vane migā;

Tattha nīḷaṃ paḷinaṃ sakuṇīvāti yathā sakuṇikā mukhatuṇḍakena gocaraṃ gahetvā kenaci upaddavena sakuṇapotakānaṃ paḷinattā paḷinaṃ sakuṇinīḷaṃ āgaccheyya, yathā vā gatasiṅgaṃ nikkhantavacchakaṃ ālayaṃ suññaṃ vacchakasālaṃ vacchagiddhinī dhenu āgaccheyya, evaṃ suññaṃ assamaṃ āgacchīti attho.
Tadā hi sotthiseno sambulāya ciramānāya “itthiyo nāma lolā, paccāmittampi me gahetvā āgaccheyyā”ti parisaṅkanto paṇṇasālato nikkhamitvā gacchantaraṃ pavisitvā nisīdi.
Apassantīti tasmiṃ vane nāthaṃ attano patiṃ apassantī ito cito ca sandhāvamānā paridevesi.
Sampannacaraṇeti saha sīlena aṭṭhannaṃ samāpattīnaṃ vasena ca sampannacaraṇe ise vandeti evaṃ vatvā rājaputtaṃ apassantī tumhākaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā amhi.
Sace me sāmikassa nisinnaṭṭhānaṃ jānātha, ācikkhathāti paridevesīti attho.
Tiṇā latāni osajhoti antopheggubahisāratiṇāni ca latāni ca antosāraosadhiyo ca.
Taṃ evaṃ paridevamānaṃ disvā sotthiseno cintesi –
“ayaṃ ativiya paridevati, na kho panassā bhāvaṃ jānāmi, sace mayi sinehena evaṃ karoti, hadayampissā phaleyya, pariggaṇhissāmi tāva nan”ti gantvā paṇṇasāladvāre nisīdi.
Sāpi paridevamānāva paṇṇasāladvāraṃ gantvā tassa pāde vanditvā “kuhiṃ gatosi, devā”ti āha.
Atha naṃ so,“bhadde, tvaṃ aññesu divasesu na imāya velāya āgacchasi, ajja atisāyaṃ āgatāsī”ti pucchanto gāthamāha –
Kena nujja samāgacchi, ko te piyataro mayā”ti.

Atha naṃ sā “ahaṃ, ayyaputta, phalāphalāni ādāya āgacchantī ekaṃ dānavaṃ passiṃ, so mayi paṭibaddhacitto hutvā maṃ hatthe gaṇhitvā ‘sace mama vacanaṃ na karosi, khādissāmi tan’ti āha, ahaṃ tāya velāya taññeva anusocantī evaṃ paridevin”ti vatvā gāthamāha –
Na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ, yaṃ maṃ khādeyya rakkhaso;
Yañca me ayyaputtassa, mano hessati aññathā”ti.

Athassa sesampi pavattiṃ ārocentī “tena panāhaṃ, deva, dānavena gahitā attānaṃ vissajjāpetuṃ asakkontī devatujjhāpanakammaṃ akāsiṃ, atha sakko vajirahattho āgantvā ākāse ṭhito dānavaṃ santajjetvā maṃ vissajjāpetvā taṃ devasaṅkhalikāya bandhitvā tatiye pabbatantare khipitvā pakkāmi, evāhaṃ sakkaṃ nissāya jīvitaṃ labhin”ti āha.
Taṃ sutvā sotthiseno,“bhadde, hotu, mātugāmassa antare saccaṃ nāma dullabhaṃ, himavante hi bahū vanacarakatāpasavijjādharādayo santi, ko tuyhaṃ saddahissatī”ti vatvā gāthamāha –
Sā tassa vacanaṃ sutvā,“ayyaputta, ahaṃ taṃ asaddahantaṃ mama saccabaleneva tikicchissāmī”ti udakassa kalasaṃ pūretvā saccakiriyaṃ katvā tassa sīse udakaṃ āsiñcantī gāthamāha –
“Tathā maṃ saccaṃ pāletu, pālayissati ce mamaṃ;
Tattha tathā-saddo “ce maman”ti iminā saddhiṃ yojetabbo.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathāhaṃ vadāmi, tathā ce mama vacanaṃ saccaṃ, atha maṃ idānipi pāletu, āyatimpi pālessati, idāni me vacanaṃ suṇātha “yathāhaṃ nābhijānāmī”ti.
Potthakesu pana “tathā maṃ saccaṃ pāletī”ti likhitaṃ, taṃ aṭṭhakathāyaṃ natthi.
Evaṃ tāya saccakiriyaṃ katvā udake āsittamatteyeva sotthisenassa kuṭṭhaṃ ambilena dhotaṃ viya tambamalaṃ tāvadeva apagacchi.
Te katipāhaṃ tattha vasitvā araññā nikkhamma bārāṇasiṃ patvā uyyānaṃ pavisiṃsu.

Rājā tesaṃ āgatabhāvaṃ ñatvā uyyānaṃ gantvā tattheva sotthisenassa chattaṃ ussāpetvā sambulaṃ aggamahesiṭṭhāne abhisiñcāpetvā nagaraṃ pavesetvā sayaṃ isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā uyyāne vāsaṃ kappesi, rājanivesaneyeva ca nibaddhaṃ bhuñji.
Sotthisenopi sambulāya aggamahesiṭṭhānamattameva adāsi, na punassā koci sakkāro ahosi, atthibhāvampissā na aññāsi, aññāheva itthīhi saddhiṃ abhirami.
Sambulā sapattidosavasena kisā ahosi upaṇḍupaṇḍukajātā dhamanīsanthatagattā.
Sā ekadivasaṃ sokavinodanatthaṃ bhuñjituṃ āgatassa sasuratāpasassa santikaṃ gantvā taṃ katabhattakiccaṃ vanditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
Dhanuggahānañca satāni soḷasa, kathaṃvidhe passasi bhadde sattavo”ti.
Tassattho – bhadde, sambule ye amhākaṃ sattasatā kuñjarā, tesaññeva khandhagatānaṃ yodhānaṃ vasena uyyuttāvudhā, aparāni ca soḷasadhanuggahasatāni rattindivaṃ bārāṇasiṃ rakkhanti.
Evaṃ surakkhite nagare kathaṃvidhe tvaṃ sattavo passasi.
Bhadde, yassā tava sāsaṅkā sappaṭibhayā araññā āgatakālepi pabhāsampannaṃ sarīraṃ, idāni pana milātā paṇḍupalāsavaṇṇā ativiya kilantindriyāsi, kassa nāma tvaṃ bhāyasī”ti pucchi.
Sā tassa vacanaṃ sutvā “putto te, deva, mayi na purimasadiso”ti vatvā pañca gāthā abhāsi –
Tāsaṃ suṇitvā mitagītavāditaṃ, na dāni me tāta tathā yathā pure.
Senopiyā tāta aninditaṅgiyo, khattiyakaññā paṭilobhayanti naṃ.
“Sace ahaṃ tāta tathā yathā pure, patiṃ tamuñchāya punā vane bhare;
Sammānaye maṃ na ca maṃ vimānaye, itopi me tāta tato varaṃ siyā.
Sabbaṅgupetā patino ca appiyā, abajjha tassā maraṇaṃ tato varaṃ.
“Api ce daliddā kapaṇā anāḷhiyā, kaṭādutīyā patino ca sā piyā;
Sabbaṅgupetāyapi appiyāya, ayameva seyyā kapaṇāpi yā piyā”ti.
Haṃsagaggarāti evarūpā haṃsā viya madhurassarā nāriyo passati.
Tāsanti so tava putto tāsaṃ nārīnaṃ mitagītavāditādīni suṇitvā idāni me, tāta, yathā pure, tathā na pavattatīti vadati.

Sace ahanti, tāta, yathā pure sace ahaṃ punapi taṃ patiṃ tatheva kuṭṭharogena vanaṃ paviṭṭhaṃ uñchāya tasmiṃ vane bhareyyaṃ, punapi maṃ so sammāneyya na vimāneyya, tato me itopi bārāṇasirajjato taṃ araññameva varaṃ siyā sapattidosena sussantiyāti dīpeti.

Ayaṃ kirassā adhippāyo – yā nārī vipulannapāne ghare ekikāva asapatti samānā vimaṭṭhābharaṇā nānālaṅkārehi alaṅkatā sabbehi guṇaṅgehi upetā patino ca appiyā hoti, abajjha gīvāya valliyā vā rajjuyā vā bandhitvā tassā tato gharāvāsato maraṇameva varataranti.
Seyyāti kapaṇāpi samānā yā patino piyā, ayameva uttamāti.
